trust_decision.summary: The JWT HS256 signing key must not be a missing, empty, known-default or short secret; the decision is made in jwt.NewTokenAuth, which takes the viper-merged auth_jwt_secret with no validation today, so the fix adds a refusal there and changes the two shipped sources of that value (dev.env and the cobra viper default).

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names a hardcoded JWT secret "random"; the shipped config file is the first artefact an engineer greps for, and the viper default at cmd/serve.go:35 is its twin.

fix_sites.entry_point: jwt.NewTokenAuth() exported constructor (public API), reached from pwdless.NewResource (auth/pwdless/api.go:51) -> api.New (api/api.go:41) -> `go-base serve` (cmd/serve.go:17) and `go-base gendoc -r` (cmd/gendoc.go:50)
same constructor: new ErrWeakSecret / ErrSecretTooShort values returned to every caller of jwt.NewTokenAuth()
`go-base serve` cobra command init(): viper.SetDefault("auth_jwt_secret", ...) supplies the value the constructor reads

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The cobra viper default only applies when no dev.env is present, so an engineer who fixed dev.env:10 can argue that the default in the serve command is a zero-config dev convenience and not a production route.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The "random" sentinel at tokenauth.go:23-25 hands out an ephemeral per-boot secret, which is what lets the app and its test suite run with no secret configured; the harness seeds exactly that literal, so rejecting or deleting "random" without updating it makes TestMain bail at api_test.go:44 and CI (`go test -v ./...`) fail.

O6_input_shapes: the sentinel literal "random" (previously replaced by an ephemeral random secret)
the empty string (AUTH_JWT_SECRET= in dev.env, or unset key with no env var)
any other short value under 32 characters
other common weak literals: CHANGE-ME, secret, changeme, jwt_secret, your-secret-key
the same value arriving by env var (viper.AutomaticEnv), dev.env file, or viper default

O8_uncovered_routes.route: `go-base gendoc -r` builds the whole API with api.New(false) and discards the error, so the new weak-secret refusal is swallowed and a nil router is handed to docgen.MarkdownRoutesDoc
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: gendoc is a documentation generator, not the HTTP server, so its config was never a runtime route and the fix left it alone
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package as the fix's cmd/serve.go but a different file; not touched by the fix

O8_uncovered_routes.route: the package test harness constructs pwdless.NewResource directly with viper auth_jwt_secret="random", reaching the same TokenAuth constructor without any of the production defaults
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: it is test scaffolding rather than an application route, so it can be argued out of the advisory's scope
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one package away from auth/jwt, in package pwdless

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second TokenAuth built from an explicitly supplied secret, or a rotation path passing a key set as jwtauth's verifyKey
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: JwtAuth is an exported field and jwtauth.New already takes a separate verifyKey argument (nil at tokenauth.go:28), so a maintainer adding rotation or per-tenant token auth would construct keys outside NewTokenAuth and bypass the check

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another CLI command (token minting, seeding) that builds the auth resource and ignores the error
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: gendoc already establishes the `api, _ := api.New(false)` pattern in this tree, which a maintainer would copy for a sibling command

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a sibling default beside auth_jwt_secret that also carries a credential or a fixed token (login token length/expiry, or a mirror SMTP password default)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: init() already seeds every auth default in one block, so the next credential-shaped default would be added on the adjacent line

O9_family: CWE-798 use of hard-coded credentials / weak default secret in JWT signing configuration

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.24 with toolchain go1.24.1 (go.mod:3-5); .tool-versions still pins golang 1.18
services: PostgreSQL (needed only by `serve`/`migrate`; the auth package tests use MockAuthStore and MockMailer)
O10_build.project_tests: auth/pwdless/api_test.go: TestMain (:31) plus login/token/refresh/logout tests over httptest; it sets viper auth_jwt_secret="random" (:34) and aborts if NewResource errors (:40-44). CI runs `go test -v ./...` (.github/workflows/test.yml:15). Nothing tests the secret value or the config defaults.

j.j_sites_touched: auth/jwt/tokenauth.go, auth/jwt/errors.go, cmd/serve.go (plus the config file dev.env)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Blank the "random" literal in dev.env (and the viper default) and stop there: with the key present but empty, viper returns "", and tokenauth.go:28 then builds HS256 with an empty key, which is strictly worse than the original state.
